log_file.description: Path to the log file for the Manila API server.

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are stored.

bind_host.description: IP address the Manila API server will listen on.

bind_port.description: Port on which the Manila API server listens.

api_paste_config.description: Path to the PasteDeploy configuration file.

enable_proxy_headers_parsing.description: If true, parse X-Forwarded-* headers to determine client IP and protocol.

rate_limit_incoming_requests.description: Maximum number of incoming requests per project per minute allowed (0 = unlimited).

max_shares_per_tenant.description: Maximum number of share instances allowed per tenant.

max_snapshots_per_share.description: Maximum number of snapshots allowed per share.

share_driver_list.description: List of share driver configurations (one per backend).

name.description: Logical name for the driver/backend (used in log messages and section labels).

section.description: Section name (e.g., 'DEFAULT' or '[nfs]' for custom section).

share_driver.description: Fully qualified class name of the share driver.

database_connection.description: Database connection string ( SQLAlchemy URI format ).

policy_file.description: Path to the policy definition file (YAML format).

endpoint_list.description: List of service endpoint configuration sections (optional, rarely used in modern deployments).

section.description: Section name for endpoint template config.
